**Favourites survive an upgrade.** The installer now lists `osirus/favourites.dat` as your data, next to your ROMs and banks, so installing a new version (with `install.sh` or the OpenMPC Plugin Manager) keeps your favourites. Before, an upgrade deleted them.

**README:** install and ROM steps per format (the `VST2 Plugins` folder or `install.sh`, by hand or with the Plugin Manager), and a new section on backing up and restoring your favourites, ROMs and banks.

Nothing else changed: same sound, screens and parameters. No ROMs included, as before.
